text:
lina: Deploybot just detected a deploy-related error spike after today's 09:10 rollout to hosted/gateway. Suggests rollback. Proposing a targeted rollback for the gateway route only to v4.4.2 to limit impact. Thoughts?

deploybot: Alert: error-rate jump on /gateway route (p95 timeouts and 5xx). Recommend partial rollback to v4.4.2 for route gateway-prod (confidence 0.86). Awaiting operator confirmation. Key metrics: 5xx 3.9% (baseline 0.4%), streaming aborts +7%.

chris: oncall. +1 to targeted rollback for gateway-prod. Prefer staged 30/70/100 so downstream queues don't blow up. Also hold release notes update until legal checks the wording.

marie: legal looped. If SLA impacted we need neutral wording. Suggest: "We are routing a portion of traffic to a prior model version while we investigate elevated error rates affecting a subset of gateway requests."

lina: planned commands:
```
redwoodctl traffic split --env prod --route gateway-prod --from v4.5.0 --to v4.4.2 --pct-start 30 --pct-final 100 --step-interval 4m --reason "gateway 5xx regression"
redwoodctl pin --env prod --route gateway-prod --version v4.4.2 --ttl 60m --reason "safety pin after rollback"
```

deploybot: Job queued jb-77420. Operator approval required.

chris: approving and kicking off jb-77420 now. Monitoring dashboards and trace sampler.

deploybot: Step1 complete (30%). 5xx dropped to 1.6%. Proceeding to step2 in 4m.

chris: stepping to 100% early after observing steady improvement. Shift done: 100% on v4.4.2. 5xx back to 0.45%.

lina: pin applied for 60m and auto-rollforward disabled for the route. Opening INF-5599 for RCA assigned to runtime.

marie: customer-facing blurb approved: "We routed traffic to a previous model version as a precaution while we investigate increased error rates. No customer data was affected. We'll provide updates as we learn more."

ops-bot: Status update posted to #statuspage and queued email sent to affected customers.

chris: next steps: reproduce in staging with v4.5.0, enable additional tracing, test with reduced concurrency. If we reproduce, prepare patch; if not, double-check routing config and timeouts. Reopen thread with RCA notes.

lina: thanks all. Closing this execution thread ":white_check_mark:" — will follow up in INF-5599 with timeline and release-note changes.
